GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the middle stages after being crossed near the 1000m. When qst re riding in early stages, rdr said his instructions were similar to previous starts, which was to obtain the lead, however he had an option to take a sit should another rnr show intent to lead. He said after riding his mnt along in the initial stages, & after crossing another rnr passing the 1200m, he felt the gelding was at its top & if he had continued to pressure it, this would have been detrimental to its chances, so he stopped pressuring it particularly after observing another rdr showing intent to lead.
